purpose: Prove that Queue/Brief explanations of a Work Item show full graph provenance and distinguish evidence from inference on every element, with per-element confidence and an explicit evidenceKind marker (FR20, FR19). A second explanation covers a conflicting/uncertain-evidence case where uncertainty is made visible and a guard plus receipt trail proves the Work Item was NOT auto-approved from graph evidence: its state group is unchanged and noAutoApprovalFromGraph is true. Explanations here are read-only local contract projections; every would-be live state mutation stays receipt-gated to Epic 2 and no tenant write occurs.

explanations.summary: Doug committed in the 2026-07-13 platform sync meeting note (CSR-MANUAL-MEETING-001) to send the revised tenant readiness checklist to Priya by Friday. The explanation traces the commitment back to its source record, the people and roles it names, the project/topic it concerns, and the receipt that reviewed the graph evidence without changing Work Item state.

explanations.summary: CWI-LOCAL-FOLLOWUP-001 is a proposed follow-up extracted from the mock Outlook message reference CSR-OUTLOOK-MESSAGE-MOCK-001. The source record is hash/link-only mock evidence with no authorized body content, so whether it represents actionable work is uncertain and conflicts with the inference that a follow-up is plausible. Uncertainty is made visible, the conflict is described, and a guard plus receipt trail proves the Work Item was NOT auto-approved from graph evidence: its state group stays proposed.

conflict.description: The mock Outlook message reference shape suggests a plausible follow-up, but the source record is explicitly mock/manual evidence with no authorized body content, no sensitivity labels, and no tenant permission context. The graph therefore contains evidence that a message exists but only an inference that it represents actionable work; these conflict and the matter cannot be resolved from graph evidence alone.
conflict.resolution: Unresolved from graph evidence. Uncertainty is surfaced to a human for review; no auto-approval occurred and the Work Item state group is unchanged at proposed.
